exposure: Time from uterine incision to delivery
time from uterine incision to delivery
Quintiles of time from uterine incision to delivery
Indication for cesarean section (nonreassuring fetal status or other)
outcome: Composite of hypoxia-associated neonatal outcomes (seizures, hypoxic ischemic encephalopathy, need for hypothermia treatment, and death within 7 days)
cohort: Women undergoing in-labor term cesarean deliveries in the first 2 years of an ongoing prospective cohort study
finding: Overall, duration from uterine incision to delivery for in-labor cesareans of nonanomalous term infants was not associated with an increase in risk of hypoxia-associated morbidities.
mod_finding: This study investigated the association between the time from uterine incision to delivery during cesarean section and hypoxic neonatal outcomes.
